name: shape-twinkle-sparkles
title: Twinkle Sparkles
description: Các ngôi sao bốn cánh nhỏ lần lượt loé lên rồi tắt ở các chỗ khác nhau, không bao giờ cùng lúc.

moworks.author: moworks

options.period: s each sparkle repeats (1.5); it glows in the first 35 %

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 12 four-point sparkles at seeded spots; each repeats every 1.5 s with a seeded phase and glows only in the first 35 % of its cycle: size 4 -> 4 + 10 x seed -> 4 as sin(pi u) (recipe: 600 ms, scale 0 -> 1 -> 0, ease-in-out), turning slowly at 0.5 rad / s; 2 in 3 yellow, 1 in 3 accent. Never all at once. Params: count (12) · duration mỗi lần loé (0.6 s) · seed.
